shortDescription: Creates a lock file to prevent concurrent downloads

options.name: download
options.description: A dictionary containing download-related parameters, including the URL of the file to download. The only required key in this dictionary is 'url', but it can also contain 'unzip' to indicate whether the downloaded file should be unzipped.

options.name: lock_key
options.description: Optional. A key that can be used to identify the lock owner. If provided and a lock file exists with key, the lock is considered to be owned by the current Ansible task.

options.name: path
options.description: The path where the lock file and the downloaded file will be placed. This should be a shared storage location accessible by all nodes.
